create_nixl_stats: create a NixlKVConnectorStats instance to container transfer performance metrics
record_nixl_transfer: record a successful NIXL KV cache transfer using nixlXferTelemetry data
aggregate_nixl_stats: aggregate stats from multiple NIXL connector instances into a single stats container
reduce_nixl_stats: reduce NIXL transfer stats to a compact dict with avg, p90, and throughput values
observe_nixl_metrics: observe NIXL transfer data and record it as Prometheus histograms and counters
